requirements.requirement: Standing on at least three stud spikes facing down as feet
requirements.evidence: 3 spikes variant stud facing down: spike:0#-1,0|-1,1|0,0; spike:0#0,-1|0,0|1,-1; spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 placed at level 0 junctions, facing down. Provides tripod stance.

finish.summary: Built 7-cell honeycomb (center + 6 ring) on 3 stud spikes facing down. House rules applied (capOpenFaces + lockJoints), check_build ok with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 brass heat-set insert, 7.6 mm (initeq M6-1.0 Short)
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
